text.description_html:
Acorn AK3BR, 4" Strap and Pintle Shutter Hinge

The perfect shutter hardware can really elevate a home's curb appeal. If you want something that looks as if it could have been made in the old west but will stand the test of time, Acorn's Stainless Steel 4" Connecticut Style Strap and Pintle Shutter Hinges will do just that. They are made out of stainless steel--strap, pintle and fasteners--so you know that they will last. It has a matte black finish for a rustic look.

Features and Specifications of the 4" Connecticut Style Strap and Pintle Shutter Hinge:

  • Material: Stainless steel
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Length: 4" (Measurements from center of pintles.)
  • Width: 1"
  • Pintle Length: 1/4"
  • Pintle Diameter: .27"
  • Packaged Includes: 4 strap hinges, 4 pintles, and stainless steel screws.
  • Lifetime No Rust Warranty

Priced and sold as 2 pairs (4 hinges, one set for each shutter).
